check_command_rule.command_absent_at_head: any command_path absent at the head being verified -> FAIL_CLOSED CHECK_COMMAND_ABSENT_AT_HEAD (CHECK_COMMAND_PATHS_PRESENT_AT_HEAD); the state of older heads such as StegVerse-Labs/.github#3225 (e6ba9601) and #3226 (f82c0324) for schema-validate, unit-tests and mutation-negative-suite
check_command_rule.command_undeclared: offline_command UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED -> FAIL_CLOSED CHECK_COMMAND_UNDECLARED (CHECK_HAS_OFFLINE_COMMAND); the check's receipt can never be minted
check_command_rule.evaluator: resident-runtime/sv_work_items.py::check_command, check_outcome_matches (pure over supplied paths and outputs)
check_command_rule.pass_criteria_live_in_the_row: A head never declares its own pass criteria; it binds them through required_checks_ref.blob_sha. The NWI-S1 verifier runs offline_command from the repo root at the exact head with no network (argv; placeholders only from argument_bindings) and compares the outcome with expected (exit_code; stdout_json_subset keys must equal; stderr_last_line must equal).

check_derived_issue_rule.not_ledgered: FAIL_CLOSED SOURCE_RECEIPT_NOT_LEDGERED: before the org writer appends the receipt the issue cannot be NATIVE
check_derived_issue_rule.opened_by_session: derivation:sv_work_items.derive_issue_from_check_receipt (the id never depends on who runs it; no lane owns minting)
check_derived_issue_rule.resolution_class_rule: a check-derived issue is resolved only through merge admission of an SV_CHANGE that cites it in resolves (class B, as in the P1 FAIL_CLOSED register)
check_derived_issue_rule.source_receipt_ref: the org-ledger ref of the appended receipt: refs/stegverse/organization-ledger@<commit>:receipts/<receipt_sha256 hex>.json @ receipt_sha256
check_derived_issue_rule.surface: the check's command surface (sv_work_items.check_command_surface: argv[1], the unittest module file, or this row file when the command is undeclared)

statements: (1) Lane B's NWI-S1 verifier (SV-LLM/.github#46) runs each declared check offline at the exact head and emits a six-field, head-bound receipt (schemas/sv-check-receipt.v1.schema.json) carrying the supplied hb_epoch.
(2) That receipt becomes a LEDGER_RECEIPT only through the org-ledger writer transition (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3255, the writer-only workflow) under the shared lock.
(3) The check ids in this row are exactly the ids the verifier emits; no other minter exists. A receipt for any other check id is refused (CHECK_ID_UNDECLARED).

argument_bindings.{base_commit}: supplied by the verifier: the 40-hex commit the head is verified against, already present in the local clone (no fetch); never inferred. An unresolvable base makes the script itself FAIL_CLOSED REGISTRY_GENERATION_UNREADABLE (exit 1).

command_status.next_attempt: after such a command exists in this repo and is declared in this row; until then every ledger_writer change fails closed on this check
command_status.receipt_rule: the verifier's only acceptable receipt for this check is FAIL_CLOSED CHECK_COMMAND_UNDECLARED with the six fields; validate_check_receipt refuses an ALLOW (or any other outcome) for it, and admission fails closed CHECK_COMMAND_UNDECLARED
command_status.required_evidence_or_repair: an offline command in StegVerse-Labs/.github that performs the supplied-epoch binder check (the StegVerse-org/.github#189 189-binder-check rows), declared here with offline_command, expected and command_paths; nothing in this repo performs it at d2ba0957

row_status.holds_until: an appended LEDGER_RECEIPT exists for every check id in this row (sv_work_items.row_receipt_status)
row_status.next_attempt: after StegVerse-Labs/.github#3255 and SV-LLM/.github#46 land and JD-P4-3 settles the epoch
row_status.required_evidence_or_repair: NWI-S1 verifier emits the check id at the exact head and the org writer appends it
